<h2 class="section-title">India Markets</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>RBI Policy Outlook:</strong> Analysts are divided on a potential repo rate hike in the upcoming October 5-7 MPC meeting, with some citing rising inflation and oil prices while others point to benign core inflation and growth concerns.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I1</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiowFBVV95cUxNdUhEeHNZVlMxMTVydnNHZjA5R2V3aTNnUGZ4dUtCNjVvU2Z5OXdfZkNlZHlVNklvbTQzMTAtQUR1QWxzdnN6ZTAxQU1ZOWI4ZDA5ZGFoZnc4TlVydTFVY3h3UE9BWGx3MnNmcWVoZjAyV0xSYnF5VDF4czh3VmxuYVVrTXAtUGp2X2pnYnhQMk1ScG5fWjR6dHJVMlpkQjhJQ1hB?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I2</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I4</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I6</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I18</a></span></li>

</ul>

<h2 class="section-title">Global Cues</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Bond Yields and Currency Pressure:</strong> Global bond markets are under stress with the US 10-year Treasury yield hitting a 24-year high, contributing to domestic 10-year yields breaching 7.20% and the rupee sliding to 96.31.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W9</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W10</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W13</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Market Sentiment:</strong> Indian indices have recorded their longest weekly losing streak in 25 years, resulting in a market capitalization wipeout of Rs 7.4 lakh crore over the past week.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W2</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W8</a></span></li>
</ul>
